% Motion to reopen: must state new relevant facts supported by documentary evidence.
new_facts_stated :-
    factual_statements_submitted_on_motion,
    motion_facts_relate_to_hardship,
    motion_facts_not_previously_submitted.

motion_to_reopen_requirements_met :-
    filed_motion_to_reopen,
    new_facts_stated,
    documentary_evidence_submitted.

% Motion to reconsider: must show incorrect application of law or policy and an incorrect decision on the existing record.
incorrect_application_of_law_or_policy_established :-
    applicant_argued_totality_not_considered,
    \+ no_specific_legal_or_policy_error_established.

prior_decision_incorrect_on_record_established :-
    \+ no_record_error_established,
    extreme_hardship_to_qualifying_relative.

motion_to_reconsider_requirements_met :-
    filed_motion_to_reconsider,
    incorrect_application_of_law_or_policy_established,
    prior_decision_incorrect_on_record_established.

% Section 212(i) waiver eligibility requires extreme hardship to a U.S. citizen or LPR spouse or parent.
qualifying_relative_is_covered_parent_or_spouse :-
    mother_qualifying_relative,
    mother_is_parent,
    mother_us_citizen.

close_caregiving_relationship :-
    applicant_lives_one_block_from_mother,
    applicant_transports_mother_to_medical_appointments,
    applicant_cooks_for_mother,
    applicant_cleans_for_mother,
    applicant_does_mothers_laundry.

vulnerable_qualifying_relative :-
    mother_age_86,
    mother_widowed,
    medical_documentation_shows_chronic_conditions,
    medical_documentation_shows_medication_use.

substantial_hardship_factors_present :-
    close_caregiving_relationship,
    vulnerable_qualifying_relative.

medically_required_personal_care_by_applicant :-
    medical_documentation_shows_chronic_conditions,
    \+ medical_docs_do_not_show_applicant_required_for_care,
    \+ record_contains_no_physician_statement_applicant_required_caregiver.

reasonable_alternative_caregiver_available :-
    mother_lives_with_applicant_brother.

reasonable_alternative_caregiver_available :-
    mother_currently_has_household_caregiver_brother.

reasonable_alternative_caregiver_available :-
    brother_says_maybe_could_provide_care.

no_reasonable_alternative_caregiver_available :-
    \+ reasonable_alternative_caregiver_available.

separation_hardship_severe_and_unmitigated :-
    substantial_hardship_factors_present,
    medically_required_personal_care_by_applicant,
    no_reasonable_alternative_caregiver_available.

qualifying_relative_would_relocate_to_mexico :-
    \+ no_evidence_mother_would_relocate_to_mexico.

severe_relocation_hardship :-
    mother_age_86,
    medical_documentation_shows_chronic_conditions,
    \+ no_medical_evidence_relocation_contraindicated.

relocation_hardship_severe_and_unmitigated :-
    qualifying_relative_would_relocate_to_mexico,
    severe_relocation_hardship.

hardship_exceeds_usual_or_expected :-
    separation_hardship_severe_and_unmitigated.

hardship_exceeds_usual_or_expected :-
    relocation_hardship_severe_and_unmitigated.

extreme_hardship_to_qualifying_relative :-
    qualifying_relative_is_covered_parent_or_spouse,
    hardship_exceeds_usual_or_expected.

waiver_eligibility_established :-
    found_inadmissible_for_fraud_or_misrepresentation,
    sought_section_212_i_waiver,
    extreme_hardship_to_qualifying_relative.

motion_grantable_reopen :-
    motion_to_reopen_requirements_met,
    waiver_eligibility_established.

motion_grantable_reconsider :-
    motion_to_reconsider_requirements_met,
    waiver_eligibility_established.

eligibility_met :-
    found_inadmissible_for_fraud_or_misrepresentation,
    sought_section_212_i_waiver,
    (   motion_grantable_reopen
    ;   motion_grantable_reconsider
    ).

decision(Result) :-
    (   eligibility_met
    ->  Result = 'Accepted'
    ;   Result = 'Dismissed'
    ).

main :-
    catch(
        (   decision(Result),
            writeln(Result)
        ),
        error(existence_error(procedure, PI), _),
        handle_undefined(PI)
    ).

handle_undefined(Name/Arity) :-
    (   current_predicate(Name/OtherArity),
        OtherArity \= Arity
    ->  format('Programming error: called ~w/~w, but only ~w/~w is defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity, Name, OtherArity])
    ;   format('Lack of information: predicate ~w/~w is not defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity])
    ).

:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Should this case be accepted or dismissed?
